Went once to have a look. Second time left with plenty of advises, a mouse toy that my kitten is in love with and Cat Litter Tofu.

I find the Tofu great, much cleaner and easy to handle it. Environmental friendly, 100 natural, without weird smell and flushable. Much better then the sand that I tried before and caused accidents and discomfort to both of us.

Very disappointed. I’ve been shopping at this pet store for 1,5 years and this unpleasant experience happened twice. The guy around 30 yo who works in this store charges more products than you buy. First time I bought 5 things and he charges for 7 things and when I got home and saw the receipt I found out I was charged more than I had to be. Another time I bought 2 items and was charged 3 and I told the cashier that I only had 2 items bought and he apologised and said it was an accident but I’m quite sure that wasn’t an accident.(it was the same man). I’m very disappointed cause this is the only pet stope near to my house and I used to go there regularly.I won’t be back in this shop again. Thanks

We were on holiday in Dublin, looking for something to bring back to our cat. She has only really shown interest in King Catnip toys, and when we mentioned this to the staff, they told us they had a particular product that was chemically equivalent. We were a little sceptical but bought a packet anyway. We have just watched her absolutely go to town on a mousie that was briefly dipped in the stuff, and she is now purring contentedly on the sofa in a very cuddly mood. These folks know their stuff! Let them help you care for your pets! ❤️😻😁
